theme: Light Theme - Swiss Brutalist & Calm Minimalist

typography.rules: Strictly avoid Inter, Roboto, and generic sans-serifs. Do not center-align indiscriminately. Use font-extrabold for H1, font-bold for H2, and font-normal for body text. Enforce tight tracking (tracking-tight) on headings.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Extremely minimal. Avoid drop shadows on static elements. Use purely border-based separation (1px solid #E8E8E3). Floating bars (like the call control bar) can have a soft shadow: shadow-lg or shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08)].
visual_enhancers.radii: Use rounded-md (6px) or rounded-sm (2px). No fully rounded pills except for the floating bottom audio control bar.

grids.audio_room: Dynamic grid. Up to 2 participants use large spanning tiles. 3+ use grid-cols-2 to grid-cols-4 with gap-4.

layouts.spacing: Generous. Use Tailwind spacing scale p-8, p-12. Allow containers breathing room.
layouts.alignment: Left-align text, headers, and form inputs. Avoid centered layouts unless explicitly for empty states.

motion.micro_interactions: Hover states should subtly dim or shift background colors. transition-colors duration-200.
motion.speaking_indicator: Soft opacity pulse on a crisp green border (border-[#4C7D5B]) around the participant tile. Do not scale or move layout elements.

accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, list items) MUST have a data-testid attribute.
accessibility.focus_states: High contrast focus rings. focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#3A4F41]/20 focus:border-[#3A4F41].

media.icons: lucide-react, styled with stroke-width 1.5 for elegance.
media.avatars: If no user image, use minimal typographic initials with a calm background (bg-[#F2F2F0] text-[#111111]).

3d_libraries: None. The calm minimal aesthetic requires a strict 2D layout without 3D webGL distractions.

image_urls.description: Minimal clean workspace, to be used as a subtle mood image on the landing page.
People collaborating in a calm setting, for the about/features section.

instructions_to_main_agent: Initialize React with JavaScript (.js extension), NOT TypeScript (.tsx).
Integrate LiveKit Cloud for audio conferencing. Implement logic to list rooms, join a room via code, and manage host permissions (kick/mute).
Use MongoDB + FastAPI for the backend. Use JWT for authentication.
The in-room interface should display a grid of participant tiles with speaking indicators and host controls.
Strip default Vercel-like styling from Shadcn UI. Apply the crisp, earthy-minimal aesthetic outlined in these guidelines.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic AI slop. Maintain high contrast, negative space, and strict typography rules.
Do not use dark colors as gradients. Use solid colors.
Do not center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Include a data-testid on every interactive element.
